# Leave policy

## Annual leave
Full-time employees accrue 25 days of annual leave per calendar year. Requests must be submitted
at least ten working days in advance and are approved by the employee's line manager.

## Sick leave
Sick leave does not require advance notice. A medical certificate is required after three
consecutive days.

## Parental leave
Parental leave is up to 26 weeks and must be requested at least eight weeks before it starts.

## Cancellation
A pending or approved request can be cancelled by the employee until the day before it starts.
